props.title: Makeup by Sameera: bridal hair and makeup in Denver.
props.lede: Most people want to look like themselves on their wedding day, and they want that to come through in the photographs, too. Makeup by Sameera is a great choice if that sounds like you.

headingText.html: Sameera Ahmed is a Denver makeup and hair artist, and she’s available on location. Her looks range from natural to eccentric, so she can go as soft or as bold as you like.

props.title: Makeup by Sameera at a glance

rows.text: She offers bridal makeup and hair, and she also works on editorial, runway and commercial projects, including men’s grooming.
She’s based in Denver, and she also takes destination work.
She’s worked with brands including Yves Saint Laurent, Giorgio Armani, Bobbi Brown and Estée Lauder.
The brands she has supported include The North Face, Frontier Airlines, Aveeno and Pact.

props.html: Bridal hair and makeup in Denver
Sameera says it’s an honor to help people feel beautiful on one of the most important days of their lives. She works to bring out your best in a way that represents your own style.

She has a keen eye for detail and a strong sense of color, light and texture, and she’s worked with some of the most talented photographers in Denver. That’s a big help on a day when you’ll be in so many photographs.

Her bridal portfolio includes soft, monochromatic peach looks and Desi bridal makeup, and she specializes in skin of all ethnicities and tones. She also brings a gentle hand and an uplifting attitude, which is lovely to have around when there’s a lot going on.

props.html: All of the makeup on this page is by Sameera Ahmed, and the photographs come from her portfolio.
Makeup and hair for photo and video shoots

If your company is planning a photo or video shoot, Sameera supports commercial productions, too. She has a background in corporate marketing and branding, so she’ll think about how hair and makeup fit your brand.
You can see more of her work in her bridal portfolio, her beauty and editorial portfolio and her commercial portfolio.
To check your date or ask about a shoot, reach out to Sameera through her website.
